public readonly struct Option<T>
{
    private readonly T? value;
    private Option(T? value, bool isSome)
    {
        this.value = value;
        IsSome = isSome;
    }

    public bool IsSome { get; }
    public bool IsNone => !IsSome;
    public T Value => IsSome ? value! : throw new System.InvalidOperationException("called Option::unwrap() on None");

    public T Unwrap() => Value;
    public T UnwrapOr(T fallback) => IsSome ? value! : fallback;
    public bool IsEmpty() => IsNone;
    public static Option<T> Some(T value) => new(value, true);
    public static Option<T> None() => new(default, false);
    public override string ToString() => IsSome ? "Some(" + value!.ToString() + ")" : "None";
}

    )
    {
        this.Self = self;
        this.Impl = showImpl;
        this.DisplayName = displayName;
    }

    public static Error FromObject<T, TImpl>(T value)
        where TImpl : IShowImpl<T, TImpl> =>
        new Error(value!, ShowImplObject<T, TImpl>.Instance, "");
    public static Error FromObject(object value, string displayName) =>
        new Error(value!, null, displayName);
    public static Error FromObject(object value, string displayName, IShowImpl impl) =>
        new Error(value!, impl, displayName);

    public override string ToString() =>
        Impl is not null ? Impl.ToString(Self) : DisplayName;

    public Unit Output(Logger logger)
    {
        logger.WriteString(ToString());
        return Unit.Value;
    }

public interface IShowImpl<T, TImpl>
    where TImpl : IShowImpl<T, TImpl>
{
    static virtual Unit Output(T value, Logger logger)
    {
        logger.WriteString(TImpl.ToString(value));
        return Unit.Value;
    }

    static virtual string ToString(T value) =>
        ShowSupport.ToMoonBitStringViaOutput<T, TImpl>(value);
}

public static class ShowSupport
{
    public static string QuoteString(string value) => "\"" + value.Replace("\\", "\\\\", System.StringComparison.Ordinal).Replace("\"", "\\\"", System.StringComparison.Ordinal) + "\"";

    public static string ToMoonBitStringViaOutput<T, TShowImpl>(T value)
        where TShowImpl : IShowImpl<T, TShowImpl>
    {
        var logger = new StringBuilder();
        TShowImpl.Output(value, new Logger(logger, StringBuilderAsLogger.Instance));
        return logger.ToString();
    }

public static partial class Intrinsics
{
    public static Unit Ignore<T>(T value) => Unit.Value;

    public static T ArrayRemove<T>(Array<T> self, int index)
    {
        if ((uint)index >= (uint)self.Length)
        {
            throw new Panic("panic");
        }

        var value = self.buf[index];
        System.Array.Copy(self.buf, index + 1, self.buf, index, self.Length - index - 1);
        self.Length--;
        self.buf[self.Length] = default!;
        return value;
    }

    public static Array<T> ArrayMake<T>(int length, T value)
    {
        var result = new Array<T>(length);
        for (var i = 0; i < length; i++)
        {
            ArrayUtility.Push(result, value);
        }

        return result;
    }

    public static Option<T> ArrayLast<T>(Array<T> self)
    {
        return self.Length == 0
            ? Option<T>.None()
            : Option<T>.Some(self.buf[self.Length - 1]);
    }

    public static Array<T> ArrayFilter<T>(Array<T> self, System.Func<T, bool> predicate)
    {
        var result = new Array<T>();
        for (var i = 0; i < self.Length; i++)
        {
            var item = self.buf[i];
            if (predicate(item))
            {
                ArrayUtility.Push(result, item);
            }
        }

        return result;
    }

    public static Unit ArraySortBy<T>(Array<T> self, System.Func<T, T, int> compare)
    {
        System.Array.Sort(self.buf, 0, self.Length, System.Collections.Generic.Comparer<T>.Create((left, right) => compare(left, right)));
        return Unit.Value;
    }

    public static Unit PrintlnString(string value)
    {
        System.Console.WriteLine(value);
        return Unit.Value;
    }

    public static Option<int> StringViewFind(StringView self, StringView needle)
    {
        var index = self.AsSpan().IndexOf(needle.AsSpan(), System.StringComparison.Ordinal);
        return index < 0 ? Option<int>.None() : Option<int>.Some(index);
    }

    public static StringView StringViewView(StringView self, int startOffset, Option<int> endOffset)
    {
        return self.Sub(startOffset, endOffset.IsSome ? endOffset.Value : self.Length);
    }

    public static Option<int> StringGetChar(string self, int index)
    {
        if ((uint)index >= (uint)self.Length)
        {
            return Option<int>.None();
        }

        var current = self[index];
        if (char.IsHighSurrogate(current))
        {
            if (index + 1 >= self.Length || !char.IsLowSurrogate(self[index + 1]))
            {
                return Option<int>.None();
            }

            return Option<int>.Some(char.ConvertToUtf32(current, self[index + 1]));
        }

        return char.IsLowSurrogate(current)
            ? Option<int>.None()
            : Option<int>.Some(current);
    }

    public static Option<int> StringViewGetChar(StringView self, int index)
    {
        if ((uint)index >= (uint)self.Length)
        {
            return Option<int>.None();
        }

        return StringGetChar(self.Data, self.Start + index);
    }

    public static Array<int> StringToArray(StringView self)
    {
        var values = new System.Collections.Generic.List<int>();
        var index = self.Start;
        while (index < self.End)
        {
            var current = self.Data[index];
            if (char.IsHighSurrogate(current) && index + 1 < self.End && char.IsLowSurrogate(self.Data[index + 1]))
            {
                values.Add(char.ConvertToUtf32(current, self.Data[index + 1]));
                index += 2;
            }
            else
            {
                values.Add(current);
                index++;
            }
        }

        return new Array<int>(values.ToArray());
    }

    public static bool StringContainsChar(StringView self, int value)
    {
        var index = self.Start;
        while (index < self.End)
        {
            var current = self.Data[index];
            if (char.IsHighSurrogate(current) && index + 1 < self.End && char.IsLowSurrogate(self.Data[index + 1]))
            {
                if (char.ConvertToUtf32(current, self.Data[index + 1]) == value)
                {
                    return true;
                }

                index += 2;
            }
            else
            {
                if (current == value)
                {
                    return true;
                }

                index++;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public static int StringCharLength(StringView self)
    {
        var count = 0;
        var index = self.Start;
        while (index < self.End)
        {
            var current = self.Data[index];
            index += char.IsHighSurrogate(current) && index + 1 < self.End && char.IsLowSurrogate(self.Data[index + 1]) ? 2 : 1;
            count++;
        }

        return count;
    }

    public static string StringMake(int length, int value)
    {
        var text = char.ConvertFromUtf32(value);
        return string.Create(text.Length * length, text, static (span, item) =>
        {
            for (var i = 0; i < span.Length; i += item.Length)
            {
                item.AsSpan().CopyTo(span[i..]);
            }
        });
    }

    public static StringView StringViewTrim(StringView self, StringView chars)
    {
        return StringViewTrimEnd(StringViewTrimStart(self, chars), chars);
    }

    public static StringView StringViewTrimStart(StringView self, StringView chars)
    {
        var start = self.Start;
        while (start < self.End && chars.AsSpan().IndexOf(self.Data[start]) >= 0)
        {
            start++;
        }

        return new StringView(self.Data, start, self.End);
    }

    public static StringView StringViewTrimEnd(StringView self, StringView chars)
    {
        var end = self.End;
        while (end > self.Start && chars.AsSpan().IndexOf(self.Data[end - 1]) >= 0)
        {
            end--;
        }

        return new StringView(self.Data, self.Start, end);
    }
}

public static class CompareSupport
{
    public static int Compare<T>(T left, T right)
    {
        if (left is string leftString && right is string rightString)
        {
            return string.Compare(leftString, rightString, System.StringComparison.Ordinal);
        }

        return System.Collections.Generic.Comparer<T>.Default.Compare(left, right);
    }
}

public static class OptionEq
{
    public static bool equal<T, TEqImpl>(Option<T> self, Option<T> other)
        where TEqImpl : IEqImpl<T, TEqImpl>
    {
        if (self.IsNone || other.IsNone)
        {
            return self.IsNone && other.IsNone;
        }

        return Eq.equal<T, TEqImpl>(self.Value, other.Value);
    }

    public static bool equal_nullable_reference<T, TEqImpl>(T? self, T? other)
        where T : class
        where TEqImpl : IEqImpl<T, TEqImpl>
    {
        if (self is null || other is null)
        {
            return self is null && other is null;
        }

        return Eq.equal<T, TEqImpl>(self, other);
    }
}

public interface IEqImpl
{
    bool equal(object left, object right);
    bool not_equal(object left, object right) => !equal(left, right);
}

public interface IEqImpl<T, TImpl>
    where TImpl : IEqImpl<T, TImpl>
{
    static abstract bool equal(T left, T right);
    static virtual bool not_equal(T left, T right) => !TImpl.equal(left, right);
}

    public static bool equal<T, TImpl>(T left, T right)
        where TImpl : IEqImpl<T, TImpl> => TImpl.equal(left, right);

    public static bool not_equal<T, TImpl>(T left, T right)
        where TImpl : IEqImpl<T, TImpl> => TImpl.not_equal(left, right);
}

public sealed class Array<T>
{
    public T[] buf;
    public int Length;
    public int Count => Length;

    public Array()
    {
        buf = [];
        Length = 0;
    }

    public Array(int capacity)
    {
        buf = new T[capacity];
        Length = 0;
    }

    public Array(System.ReadOnlySpan<T> items)
    {
        buf = items.ToArray();
        Length = buf.Length;
    }

    public Array(T[] buffer)
    {
        buf = buffer;
        Length = buffer.Length;
    }

    public Array(T[] buffer, int length)
    {
        buf = buffer;
        Length = length;
    }

    public T this[int index] { get => ArrayUtility.At(this, index); set => ArrayUtility.Set(this, index, value); }

    public System.ReadOnlySpan<T> AsSpan() => buf.AsSpan(0, Length);

    public static Array<T> MakeUninit(int length) => new(new T[length], length);

    public static Array<T> operator +(Array<T> left, Array<T> right) =>
        ArrayUtility.Concat(left, right);

    public static Array<T> operator +(Array<T> left, ArrayView<T> right) =>
        ArrayUtility.Concat(left, right);

}

public static class ArrayUtility
{
    public static Array<T> FromSpan<T>(System.ReadOnlySpan<T> items) => new(items);
    public static Array<T> FromArray<T>(T[] items) => new(items.AsSpan());
    public static bool IsEmpty<T>(Array<T> array) => array.Length == 0;

    public static Array<T> Concat<T>(Array<T> left, Array<T> right)
    {
        var result = new Array<T>(new T[left.Length + right.Length], left.Length + right.Length);
        left.AsSpan().CopyTo(result.buf);
        right.AsSpan().CopyTo(result.buf.AsSpan(left.Length));
        return result;
    }

    public static Array<T> Concat<T>(Array<T> left, ArrayView<T> right)
    {
        var result = new Array<T>(new T[left.Length + right.Length], left.Length + right.Length);
        left.AsSpan().CopyTo(result.buf);
        right.AsSpan().CopyTo(result.buf.AsSpan(left.Length));
        return result;
    }

    public static T At<T>(Array<T> array, int index)
    {
        var len = array.Length;
        if (index < 0 || index >= len)
        {
            throw new Panic("panic");
        }

        return array.buf[index];
    }

    public static T UnsafeGet<T>(Array<T> array, int index) => array.buf[index];

    public static Option<T> Get<T>(Array<T> array, int index)
    {
        var len = array.Length;
        return index >= 0 && index < len ? Option<T>.Some(array.buf[index]) : Option<T>.None();
    }

    public static Unit Set<T>(Array<T> array, int index, T value)
    {
        var len = array.Length;
        if (index < 0 || index >= len)
        {
            throw new Panic("panic");
        }

        array.buf[index] = value;
        return Unit.Value;
    }

    public static Unit UnsafeSet<T>(Array<T> array, int index, T value)
    {
        array.buf[index] = value;
        return Unit.Value;
    }

    public static Unit Push<T>(Array<T> array, T item)
    {
        EnsureCapacity(array, array.Length + 1);
        array.buf[array.Length] = item;
        array.Length += 1;
        return Unit.Value;
    }

    public static Option<T> Pop<T>(Array<T> array)
    {
        if (array.Length == 0)
        {
            return Option<T>.None();
        }

        var index = array.Length - 1;
        var item = array.buf[index];
        array.buf[index] = default!;
        array.Length = index;
        return Option<T>.Some(item);
    }

    public static Array<T> Copy<T>(Array<T> array)
    {
        var copy = new T[array.Length];
        System.Array.Copy(array.buf, copy, array.Length);
        return new Array<T>(copy, array.Length);
    }

    public static Unit ReserveCapacity<T>(Array<T> array, int capacity)
    {
        EnsureCapacity(array, capacity);
        return Unit.Value;
    }

    public static Unit ShrinkToFit<T>(Array<T> array)
    {
        if (array.buf.Length != array.Length)
        {
            System.Array.Resize(ref array.buf, array.Length);
        }

        return Unit.Value;
    }

    public static Unit UnsafeTruncateToLength<T>(Array<T> array, int length)
    {
        if (length < array.Length)
        {
            System.Array.Clear(array.buf, length, array.Length - length);
        }

        array.Length = length;
        return Unit.Value;
    }

    public static string JoinStrings(Array<string> array, string separator)
    {
        if (array.Length == 0)
        {
            return "";
        }

        var builder = new System.Text.StringBuilder(array.buf[0]);
        for (var i = 1; i < array.Length; i++)
        {
            builder.Append(separator);
            builder.Append(array.buf[i]);
        }

        return builder.ToString();
    }

    private static void EnsureCapacity<T>(Array<T> array, int capacity)
    {
        if (array.buf.Length >= capacity)
        {
            return;
        }

        var next = array.buf.Length == 0 ? 8 : array.buf.Length * 2;
        while (next < capacity)
        {
            next *= 2;
        }

        System.Array.Resize(ref array.buf, next);
    }
}

public static class IterArrayExtensions
{
    public static Array<T> ToArray<T>(this Iter<T> iter)
    {
        var result = new Array<T>();
        while (true)
        {
            var item = iter.f();
            if (item.IsNone)
            {
                return result;
            }

            ArrayUtility.Push(result, item.Value);
        }
    }
}

public static class ArrayViewBounds
{
    public static int CheckedOffset(int startOffset, int length, int index)
    {
        if ((uint)index >= (uint)length)
        {
            throw new Panic("index out of bounds");
        }

        return startOffset + index;
    }

    public static (int Start, int Length) ValidateRange(int length, int start, int? end)
    {
        if (start < 0)
        {
            start = length + start;
        }

        var actualEnd = end ?? length;
        if (actualEnd < 0)
        {
            actualEnd = length + actualEnd;
        }

        if (start < 0 || actualEnd < start || actualEnd > length)
        {
            throw new Panic("View index out of bounds");
        }

        return (start, actualEnd - start);
    }

    public static void ValidateAbsoluteRange(int bufferLength, int start, int length)
    {
        if (start < 0 || length < 0 || start + length > bufferLength)
        {
            throw new Panic("View index out of bounds");
        }
    }
}

public readonly struct ArrayView<T>
{
    public T[] Buffer { get; }
    public int StartOffset { get; }

    public ArrayView(Array<T> array, int start = 0, int? end = null)
    {
        Buffer = array.buf;
        (StartOffset, Length) = ArrayViewBounds.ValidateRange(array.Length, start, end);
    }

    public ArrayView(T[] array, int start = 0, int? end = null)
    {
        Buffer = array;
        (StartOffset, Length) = ArrayViewBounds.ValidateRange(array.Length, start, end);
    }

    private ArrayView(T[] buffer, int start, int length, bool _)
    {
        Buffer = buffer;
        StartOffset = start;
        Length = length;
    }

    public int Length { get; }

    public System.ReadOnlySpan<T> AsSpan() => Buffer.AsSpan(StartOffset, Length);

    public T this[int index] => SourceGet(CheckedOffset(index));
    public object? GetObject(int index) => this[index];

    public static implicit operator ArrayView<T>(Array<T> array) => new(array);
    public static implicit operator ArrayView<T>(T[] array) => new(array);

    public static ArrayView<T> Make(T[] buffer, int start, int length)
    {
        ArrayViewBounds.ValidateAbsoluteRange(buffer.Length, start, length);
        return new ArrayView<T>(buffer, start, length, true);
    }

    private T SourceGet(int index) => Buffer[index];
    private int CheckedOffset(int index) =>
        ArrayViewBounds.CheckedOffset(StartOffset, Length, index);
}

public readonly struct MutArrayView<T>
{
    public T[] Buffer { get; }
    public int StartOffset { get; }

    public MutArrayView(Array<T> array, int start = 0, int? end = null)
    {
        Buffer = array.buf;
        (StartOffset, Length) = ArrayViewBounds.ValidateRange(array.Length, start, end);
    }

    public MutArrayView(T[] array, int start = 0, int? end = null)
    {
        Buffer = array;
        (StartOffset, Length) = ArrayViewBounds.ValidateRange(array.Length, start, end);
    }

    private MutArrayView(T[] buffer, int start, int length, bool _)
    {
        Buffer = buffer;
        StartOffset = start;
        Length = length;
    }

    public int Length { get; }

    public System.Span<T> AsSpan() => Buffer.AsSpan(StartOffset, Length);

    public T this[int index] { get => SourceGet(CheckedOffset(index)); set => SourceSet(CheckedOffset(index), value); }

    public object? GetObject(int index) => this[index];

    public static implicit operator MutArrayView<T>(Array<T> array) => new(array);
    public static implicit operator MutArrayView<T>(T[] array) => new(array);

    public static MutArrayView<T> Make(T[] buffer, int start, int length)
    {
        ArrayViewBounds.ValidateAbsoluteRange(buffer.Length, start, length);
        return new MutArrayView<T>(buffer, start, length, true);
    }

    private T SourceGet(int index) => Buffer[index];
    private void SourceSet(int index, T value) => Buffer[index] = value;

    private int CheckedOffset(int index) =>
        ArrayViewBounds.CheckedOffset(StartOffset, Length, index);
}

public readonly struct BytesView
{
    public BytesView(byte[] buffer, int start, int length)
    {
        if (start < 0 || length < 0 || start + length > buffer.Length)
        {
            throw new Panic("View index out of bounds");
        }

        Buffer = buffer;
        StartOffset = start;
        Length = length;
    }

    public byte[] Buffer { get; }
    public int StartOffset { get; }
    public int Length { get; }
    public System.ReadOnlySpan<byte> Span => Buffer.AsSpan(StartOffset, Length);
    public byte this[int index] => Buffer[CheckedOffset(index)];

    private int CheckedOffset(int index)
    {
        if ((uint)index >= (uint)Length)
        {
            throw new Panic($"index out of bounds: the len is from 0 to {Length} but the index is {index}");
        }

        return StartOffset + index;
    }
}

public static class FixedArray
{
    public static T[] Make<T>(int length, T value)
    {
        var items = new T[length];
        System.Array.Fill(items, value);
        return items;
    }

    public static Unit Set<T>(T[] items, int index, T value)
    {
        items[index] = value;
        return Unit.Value;
    }

    public static Unit Set<T>(Option<T>[] items, int index, T value)
    {
        items[index] = Option<T>.Some(value);
        return Unit.Value;
    }
}

public sealed class StringBuilder
{
    private readonly System.Text.StringBuilder _builder;
    public StringBuilder(int sizeHint = 0)
    {
        _builder = sizeHint > 0 ? new System.Text.StringBuilder(sizeHint) : new System.Text.StringBuilder();
    }

    public static implicit operator Logger(StringBuilder builder) =>
        new(builder, StringBuilderAsLogger.Instance);

    public Unit WriteString(string value)
    {
        _builder.Append(value);
        return Unit.Value;
    }

    public Unit WriteString(StringView value)
    {
        _builder.Append(value.AsSpan());
        return Unit.Value;
    }

    public Unit WriteChar(int value)
    {
        if(value < 0xFFFF)
        {
            _builder.Append((char)value);
        }
        else
        {
            var rune = new System.Text.Rune(value);
            System.Span<char> buffer = stackalloc char[4];
            var length = rune.EncodeToUtf16(buffer);
            _builder.Append(buffer.Slice(0, length));
        }
        return Unit.Value;
    }

    public Unit WriteSubstring(string value, int start, int length)
    {
        _builder.Append(value, start, length);
        return Unit.Value;
    }

    public Unit Reset()
    {
        _builder.Clear();
        return Unit.Value;
    }

    public override string ToString() => _builder.ToString();
}

public static class StringExtensions
{
    public static StringView View(this string value) => new(value, 0, value.Length);
    public static StringView View(this string value, int start) => value.View(start, value.Length);
    public static StringView View(this string value, int start, int end)
    {
        if (start < 0)
        {
            start = value.Length + start;
        }

        if (end < 0)
        {
            end = value.Length + end;
        }

        return new(value, start, end);
    }

    public static bool ContainsOrdinal(this string value, string part) => value.Contains(part, System.StringComparison.Ordinal);
    public static bool HasPrefix(this string value, string prefix) => value.StartsWith(prefix, System.StringComparison.Ordinal);
    public static bool HasSuffix(this string value, string suffix) => value.EndsWith(suffix, System.StringComparison.Ordinal);
    public static bool IsEmpty(this string value) => value.Length == 0;
    public static string ReplaceAll(this string value, string oldValue, string newValue) => value.Replace(oldValue, newValue, System.StringComparison.Ordinal);
    public static StringView TrimMoonBit(this string value) => value.View().Trim();
    public static string ToLowerMoonBit(this string value) => value.ToLowerInvariant();
    public static Option<StringView> BeforeMoonBit(this string value, string marker) => value.View().Before(marker);
    public static Option<StringView> AfterMoonBit(this string value, string marker) => value.View().After(marker);
    public static Option<(StringView, StringView)> SplitOnceMoonBit(this string value, string marker) => value.View().SplitOnce(marker);
}

public readonly record struct StringView(string Data, int Start, int End)
{
    public static implicit operator StringView(string value) => new(value, 0, value.Length);
    public int Length => End - Start;
    public int StartOffset => Start;
    public string Source => Data;
    public System.ReadOnlySpan<char> AsSpan() => Data.AsSpan(Start, Length);

    public ushort this[int index] => (ushort)Data[Start + index];
    public StringView Sub(int startOffset, int? endOffset = null)
    {
        var end = endOffset ?? Length;
        if (startOffset < 0)
        {
            startOffset = Length + startOffset;
        }

        if (end < 0)
        {
            end = Length + end;
        }

        if (startOffset < 0 || startOffset > end || end > Length)
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(startOffset), "Invalid index for View");
        }

        return new StringView(Data, Start + startOffset, Start + end);
    }

    public string ToOwned() => ToString();
    public override string ToString() => Data.Substring(Start, Length);
    public static bool operator ==(StringView left, string right) => right is not null && left.AsSpan().SequenceEqual(right.AsSpan());
    public static bool operator !=(StringView left, string right) => !(left == right);
    public static bool operator ==(string left, StringView right) => left is not null && left.AsSpan().SequenceEqual(right.AsSpan());
    public static bool operator !=(string left, StringView right) => !(left == right);
    public bool ContainsOrdinal(string part) => AsSpan().Contains(part.AsSpan(), System.StringComparison.Ordinal);
    public bool HasPrefix(string prefix) => AsSpan().StartsWith(prefix.AsSpan(), System.StringComparison.Ordinal);
    public bool HasSuffix(string suffix) => AsSpan().EndsWith(suffix.AsSpan(), System.StringComparison.Ordinal);
    public StringView Trim()
    {
        var start = Start;
        var end = End;
        while (start < end && char.IsWhiteSpace(Data[start]))
        {
            start++;
        }

        while (end > start && char.IsWhiteSpace(Data[end - 1]))
        {
            end--;
        }

        return new StringView(Data, start, end);
    }

    public Option<StringView> Before(string marker)
    {
        var index = Data.IndexOf(marker, Start, Length, System.StringComparison.Ordinal);
        return index < 0 ? Option<StringView>.None() : Option<StringView>.Some(new StringView(Data, Start, index));
    }

    public Option<StringView> After(string marker)
    {
        var index = Data.IndexOf(marker, Start, Length, System.StringComparison.Ordinal);
        return index < 0 ? Option<StringView>.None() : Option<StringView>.Some(new StringView(Data, index + marker.Length, End));
    }

    public Option<(StringView, StringView)> SplitOnce(string marker)
    {
        var index = Data.IndexOf(marker, Start, Length, System.StringComparison.Ordinal);
        return index < 0 ? Option<(StringView, StringView)>.None() : Option<(StringView, StringView)>.Some((new StringView(Data, Start, index), new StringView(Data, index + marker.Length, End)));
    }

}
